tasks.title: Retry loop in AsyncTaskManager._run()
tasks.description: submit() accepts retry_policy: RetryPolicy | None. _run() wraps execution in a retry loop: on failure, if attempt_number < max_retries set RETRYING, sleep, increment, retry. On cancellation during RETRYING sleep, set CANCELLED.
tdd_steps: RED: test no retry_policy -> straight to FAILED (TC-012)
RED: test retry_policy exhausted -> FAILED with correct attempt_number (TC-013)
RED: test status sequence RUNNING->RETRYING->RUNNING->FAILED (TC-015)
RED: test succeeds on retry N -> COMPLETED, attempt_number==N (TC-016)
RED: test cancel during RETRYING -> CANCELLED (TC-017)
GREEN: implement retry loop in _run(); pass retry_policy through submit()
REFACTOR: extract delay calculation, keep _run() readable
